# ECN-2026-028 - Change notice - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-HT02

Reason for change
- Field verification and audit of process records identified inconsistent quench timing for EQ-P2-L2-HT02 during ring rolling heat treat cycles. The control recipe and operator practice must be aligned to ensure metallurgical consistency and to mitigate risk of tempering variations. This ECN standardizes the allowable quench delay and updates maintenance and operating references to reflect the controlled parameter.

Affected items
- Heat treat control recipe and PLC setpoint profile for EQ-P2-L2-HT02.
- Operator instructions and checklists used on P2-L2 line.
- Preventive maintenance and calibration tasks referencing furnace timing for EQ-P2-L2-HT02.
- Referenced documents updated: MM-P2-L2-HT02, MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1, SOP-P2-L2-01.

Implementation
- The quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is 16 seconds.
- Update PLC recipe and HMI display to enforce the quench delay maximum for EQ-P2-L2-HT02; alarm on exceedance to require operator intervention per SOP-P2-L2-01.
- Revise MM-P2-L2-HT02 and MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1 to include inspection of timing actuators and verification steps to confirm the 16 seconds quench delay maximum is being met during functional checks.
- Train operators and maintenance staff on revised procedure steps in SOP-P2-L2-01; include confirmation of setpoint revision and alarm response.
- Document all changes in the equipment history log for EQ-P2-L2-HT02 and attach updated procedure copies per document control policy.

Approvals
- Engineering acceptance required for PLC recipe change and HMI update for EQ-P2-L2-HT02.
- Maintenance lead approval required for updates to MM-P2-L2-HT02 and MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1.
- Operations supervision approval required for SOP-P2-L2-01 training completion.
- Final sign-off will confirm implementation of the 16 seconds quench delay maximum for EQ-P2-L2-HT02 and that referenced documents have been updated.
